actionParameters.faq_question_answer:
Q: what is a pod ?
A: A pod is a small, wireless, device that extends your Wi-Fi network's coverage to areas with a weak signal.

Q: What do pods look like?
A: Pods are white and would have been provided by us, and they plug into an electrical outlet.

Q: What do the lights on the POD mean?
A: Lights on the POD indicate the status, they can be blinking white or green.

Q: How do I know if a POD is offline?
A: When there are no lights or a pulsing white light it can indicate the pod is offline.

Q: Where is the light that could be flashing?
A: Bell Wi-Fi PODs have a light indicator on the front of the POD. 
 
Q: What colour should the pod flash? 
A: The Bell Wi-Fi POD will typically flash a white light when attempting to pair. When the light is off, and there is power to the pod, it is working correctly.

Q: My pods are not plugged in, what do i do?
A: Through our troubleshooting i can help with that, but 1st I need to determine and isolate the issue. are your pods flashing?

Q: Where would I find my pod?
A: Bell Pods are connected into electrical outlets, Pods are white and would have been provided by Bell

Q: What power outlet should I pick?
A: You can pick another outlet that isn’t the existing one.

Q: What browser should I use?
A: you can use any browser such as Edge, Chrome or safari.

Q: when I go to the website it is asking me for an administrator password, what is it?
A: By default your administrator password is the serial number of your modem, it can be found on a label on the back of your modem.

Q: What is my administrator password?
A: By default your administrator password is the serial number of your modem, it can be found on a label on the back of your modem.

Q: why does my Whole home wi-fi have to be set to on?
A: in order for Pods to work with the Bell modem this needs to be turned on.

Q: How can I tell if this power outlet is working properly?
A: To see if the outlet is working properly you can try plugging in a charge from another device to see if it starts to charge.
